# API v2 Migration Plan

## Phase 1: Assessment
- Audit all v1 endpoints
- Identify breaking changes
- Document deprecation timeline

## Phase 2: Implementation
- Create v2 route handlers
- Implement backward compatibility layer
- Update OpenAPI specs

## Phase 3: Testing
- Integration test suite
- Load testing with k6
- Client SDK compatibility

## Phase 4: Rollout
- Canary deployment (5%)
- Gradual rollout (25% → 50% → 100%)
- Monitor error rates and latency

# Frontend Redesign Plan

## Goals
- Modernize UI with design system
- Improve accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)
- Reduce bundle size by 40%

## Timeline
- Week 1-2: Design system foundation
- Week 3-4: Core component migration
- Week 5-6: Page-level refactoring
- Week 7-8: Testing and polish

## Tech Stack
- React 19 + TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS + Radix UI
- Vite + SWC
- Playwright for E2E

# Database Optimization Plan

## Current Issues
- Slow queries on user_sessions table (>2s p99)
- Missing indexes on frequently joined columns
- N+1 queries in GraphQL resolvers

## Actions
1. Add composite indexes on (user_id, created_at)
2. Implement DataLoader for batch loading
3. Add read replicas for analytics queries
4. Set up query monitoring with pg_stat_statements
5. Implement connection pooling with PgBouncer

# Security Hardening Plan

## Priority 1 (Critical)
- Enable CSP headers
- Implement rate limiting on auth endpoints
- Rotate all API keys

## Priority 2 (High)
- Add CSRF protection
- Implement request signing
- Set up WAF rules

## Priority 3 (Medium)
- Dependency vulnerability scanning in CI
- Implement audit logging
- Set up SIEM integration

# Mobile App Launch Plan

## Phase 1: MVP (4 weeks)
- Core authentication flow
- Dashboard view
- Push notifications

## Phase 2: Feature Parity (3 weeks)
- Full CRUD operations
- Offline support
- Biometric authentication

## Phase 3: Launch (2 weeks)
- App Store submission
- Play Store submission
- Marketing materials
- Analytics integration
